messages:
Maria (Finance): Heads up — promo credits tied to contract 9876 didn't auto-apply to `inv-EU-2026-03`. Customer noticed higher than expected charge. Anyone seen this pattern before? :thinking:
Ajay (Infra Ops): Hmm, can you paste the invoice lines? my suspicion is billing routed dedicated GPU usage to a subaccount that isn't mapped to the promo. :eyes:
Maria (Finance): pasted below (redacted):
```
inv-EU-2026-03: line 1: eu-dedicated-gpu-hours 1200 $18,000
inv-EU-2026-03: line 2: network-egress-eu 3500GB $420
inv-EU-2026-03: credits_applied: $0  <-- expected $5,000 promo
```
Sasha (Sales): That promo was `PROMO-EU-50K` scoped to EU region and to the account that holds contract 9876. We explicitly asked for it to apply to dedicated usage. Expiry 2026-04-01. :calendar:
Lee (FinOps): Quick check: promo metadata shows `scope: account`, `region: eu-west-1`, `applies_to: invoice`. But billing export shows the charge on `subacct: eu-ded-1` (a subaccount created by infra for reserved pools). If promo engine evaluates at account-level it might miss subacct-tagged lines.
Ajay (Infra Ops): Right — some of our reserved pool charges are emitted with `subaccount` dimension for allocation. Billing pipeline aggregates, but credits matching is strict on `account_id` field. If subacct inherits account but credit matcher is filtering, it won't attach.
billing-bot: Automated note: Created internal investigation job `BILLING-MATCH-2901` to trace credit matching by dimension. Ticket: BILL-4321.
Maria (Finance): Thanks. Two options I see: 1) manual ledger adjustment to apply $5,000 credit to `inv-EU-2026-03` now, or 2) reassign the promo so it targets subaccount `eu-ded-1` and let it apply on next run (customer may prefer immediate fix). Which do we want?
Sasha (Sales): Customer expects a correction on this invoice. Please do manual adjustment and queue a rollback-safe reconfiguration so future invoices receive credits. I'll notify customer once done. :+1:
Lee (FinOps): I'll prepare the ledger entry. Need approval from @Maria (Finance) to post a manual credit memo referencing `inv-EU-2026-03` and contract 9876. Also flag: promo expires 2026-04-01, so reconfig should be done before next close.
Ajay (Infra Ops): Follow-up action: update billing tags on reserved capacity to include `bill_account_id: 9876` in the exporter and open infra PR to normalize dimension. That avoids future mismatch. I'll create infra ticket INFRA-998.
Maria (Finance): Approved. Lee, please proceed with manual credit memo of $5,000 and mark it as `customer-credited` with note: "Promo PROMO-EU-50K — manual application due to subaccount mapping mismatch." ETA EOD tomorrow.
billing-bot: Ticket BILL-4321 updated: workflow stage -> `manual-credit-queued`. Assigned to Lee (FinOps). ETA 24h.
Sasha (Sales): I'll draft the customer note: short apology + confirmation of manual credit on `inv-EU-2026-03`. Will send after ledger posts. :email:
Lee (FinOps): Logged journal entry draft, will post when Maria confirms final wording.
Maria (Finance): Confirmed. Also please add a postmortem item to review credit matching logic and add a test that simulates subaccount-tagged charges. Assign to @Ajay. :memo:
Ajay (Infra Ops): Adding to INFRA-998 and will sync with billing team.
Maria (Finance): Thanks everyone — closing thread when credit posts and customer notified. :white_check_mark:
